data.title: Real Sociedad vs Lyon - prediction, preview & betting tips - 05/11/2026
data.content:
Head coach Paulo Fonseca will have to do without the injured Lois Openda (leg), Pavel Sulc (meniscus), Tyler Morton (groin), and Mohamed Ouedraogo (ACL).

This will be the first clash between these sides since August 2013. Both teams have met four times in UEFA competitions in the last 22 years, and they have two wins apiece. However, Real Sociedad won the last two H2Hs.

## Real Sociedad vs Lyon form guide & betting tips

Real Sociedad vs Lyon — Last 5 Form Guide [...] Pellegrino Matarazzo will be unable to call upon the services of Arsen Zakharyan and long-term absentee Alvaro Odriozola, as both players are sidelined with injuries.

Either Mikel Oyarzabal or strike partner Luka Sucic is expected to drop to the bench in favour of Orri Oskarsson. Sergio Gomez is a strong candidate to start at right-back; the 24-year-old scored a brace in Sociedad's last Europa League outing. [...] | Real Sociedad | vs | Lyon |
